title: Scanning every key to evict
notes: The same calls as Evicting the least used key, the obvious way. put(5, 50) looks at all 3 keys (7 used 3 times, 8 twice, 9 once) to find 9. The whole run takes 13 lookups and 3 scans, 16 in all, against 24 for the lists. With 3 keys the scan is cheaper; it loses when the cache is big.
